notes: Three university-layer TLPDC documents, heavily overlapping. Main disagreements: (1) phase, whether a duty is design-time (before-course) or communication (course-start) and whether grading or data handling is during-work or general; resolved by the stage the action happens, consistently across pages. (2) actor on the data-caution lines (all vs instructor) resolved to instructor because the PDF and page address faculty. (3) unit_stance, where one coder gave a position to disclosure, sanction or caution lines; resolved by whether the passage takes a position on allowing AI (neutral if not). (4) policy_type, e.g. P05 tier vs the specific rule (P19, P04), P53 vs P101 for the AI-grading ethics lead-in, P50 vs UNCOVERED for the AI-use ledger, P32 vs UNCOVERED for faculty modelling (split into two units where one sentence holds two rules), P12 vs P14, P66 vs P09, P40 vs P35 for rubric tactics. (5) modality on 'Incorrect Use' examples and the UNESCO principles. Alignment: coder A coded the Level 1 sentence once and coder B split it into three uses; B's split was kept. Only-A units kept 14 of 14 (dropped none; one A-only Level 0 unit was realigned); only-B kept 13 of 15; dropped B's example-list coding-support unit (illustrates the rule coded on the same sentence) and B's link-title-only misconduct pointer.
